completion.downstreamInformation: PLAN alone accepts/integrates this private candidate. No Stage6 timing, Gate2, Core geometry, renderer, section4a consumer parity, Editor, Backend, public API or map admission. Producer/consumer: private TS opaque handles -> stage5_apply -> authenticated Runtime Session source/spans/default metadata/provider policy/resources -> persistent source/tree partition and bounded commands::facts -> fresh child/inverse receipts; stage5_verify independently cold-reconstructs only in QA. Explicit defaults are validated document metadata, not a new cascade: absent authored styleKey still rejects; existing provider policy supplies effective language exactly as before. Outside reuse is narrower than a run/style boundary: affected run <=32 UTF16, pure ASCII alphabetic AL, both nonempty child portions retain AL, and each actual outer neighbor is inspected Thai consonant U+0E01..U+0E2E (SA). ICU segmenter2.2 line.rs line_handle_complex_language_utf8 stops dictionary input at first non-SA; AL/AL Keep and unchanged adjacent SA/AL properties preserve those exact external dictionary inputs. Certificate records inspected edges, source/context bindings and independent fact digests; existing shard facts are verified before reuse. Other outside contexts (including AกขB cut2) reject uncertified-seam unchanged; long seam rejects budget-exhaustion. Current private Sarabun profile rejects empty RTL, A+ZWJ+B and A😀B at creation (unsupported-font-script), so no live surrogate/ZWJ cut support is claimed. Cold cost is retained once per family; accepted ancestry excludes rejected attempts, while family attempts include accepted/rejected/disposal deltas once. On accumulator/counter exhaustion, typed non-publishing rejection reports actual per-attempt work and reported-not-accumulated-overflow explicitly, with frozen prior totals; no panic/wrap or lost host capability. Logical disposal sizes are gauges, actual reclamation is allocator work. OOM/process traps remain outside retry atomicity.
